description: This is a JavaScript source file for a frontend component using LightningJS framework. It defines a 'Home' component that displays a grid of product cards, header, cart button, and checkout modal, subscribing to application store for product data and state management.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the home page with product grid and UI elements.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns the initial state object for the component, defining properties like layout, messages, and modal visibility.

methods.name: watchers
methods.description: Defines reactive watchers for width and height to recalculate layout sizes.

methods.name: subscriptions
methods.description: Sets up store subscriptions to update layout when product data or loading/error states change.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes component dimensions and loads product data if not already loaded.
